时笙救的三人都是同一个大学的学生，他们是准备去B市的安全区，但是在前面遇到了丧尸，谁知道跑回来，后面也有丧尸，两方夹击，根本就没法逃。

这三人中，领头的叫清玉，长得还挺帅气的，另外一个个子很高很瘦的叫林风，外号疯子。还有个胖子，就叫小胖。

“前面有很多丧尸？”时笙只挑自己想听，其余的直接无视了。

清玉点点头，“不然我们也不会往回跑。”

前面不知道怎么回事，特别多的丧尸。

“B市是往这个方向吗？”没有导航，也没有地图，她很怀疑自己是不是走错了路，不然为什么这么久还没到？

“应该是吧。”清玉也不是很确定的道。

时笙：“……”救了个废物。

所以她只是为了问路，才救他们的？

#宿主的脑回路实在是太奇葩了#

清玉被时笙看废物的眼神看得直冒冷汗，他刚才说错什么了吗？这姑娘身上可是有堪比炸弹的奇怪小球，他可不敢招惹她。

时笙转身就走。

清玉和另外两人对视两眼，叫住时笙，“姑娘，姑娘，我们也要去B市，不如我们一起？”

这姑娘穿得很干净，还有杀伤力那么大的武器，跟她一起走肯定是很安全的。

“我不给人当免费保镖。”时笙淡淡的道。

三人组：“……”

这妹纸是有多自信！！

好吧，人家有自信的资本。

三人有些失望，却也没纠缠，反而去收拾他们死去同伴的尸体。

“本以为我们可以一起到安全区。”清玉看着简单的土包，神情有些低落，这些人都是他的同学，末世前也就是一起上过课，算不上多好，但是末世这段时间，他们一路走来，革命友谊是有的。

“老大。”林风拍了拍清玉的肩膀，安慰道：“我们还得继续走下去，你也别太难过。”

“末世太残忍了。”小胖哭得稀里哗啦的，“我好想吃锦记的红烧猪蹄，烤鸭……”

The three people Shi Sheng rescued were all students from the same university. They were going to the safe area of City B, but they encountered zombies in front. Who knew that when they ran back, there were zombies behind them as well. They were flanked by two parties and there was no way to escape.

Among the three people, the leader is called Qing Yu, who is quite handsome, and the other is tall and thin named Lin Feng, nicknamed Madman.There is also a fat guy, let’s call him Xiaopang.

"Are there a lot of zombies ahead?" Shi Sheng only wanted to hear what he wanted to hear, and ignored the rest.

Qingyu nodded, "Otherwise we wouldn't have run back."

I don’t know what’s going on in the front, but there are so many zombies.

"Is City B heading in this direction?" There was no navigation or map. She wondered if she had gone the wrong way. Otherwise, why hadn't she arrived so long?

"It should be so." Qingyu said not very sure.

Shi Sheng: "..." Saved a loser.

So she only saved them to ask for directions?

#The host’s brain circuit is really weird#

Qingyu broke into a cold sweat because of Shi Sheng's look at the trash. Did he say something wrong just now?This girl had strange little balls on her body that were comparable to bombs, and he didn't dare to mess with her.

Shi Sheng turned around and left.

Qingyu and the other two people looked at each other and called Shi Sheng, "Girl, girl, we are also going to City B, why don't we come together?"

This girl is very cleanly dressed and has such a lethal weapon. It must be very safe to go with her.

"I don't work as a free bodyguard for others." Shi Sheng said calmly.

Group of three: "..."

How confident is this girl!!

Well, I have the capital to be confident.

The three were a little disappointed, but they didn't bother. Instead, they went to collect the bodies of their dead companions.

"I thought we could go to the safe zone together." Qingyu looked at the simple soil bag with a somewhat depressed expression. These people were all his classmates. They had attended classes together before the end of the world, which was not a good relationship. However, during the end of the world, they had a revolutionary friendship along the way.

"Boss." Lin Feng patted Qingyu on the shoulder and comforted: "We have to keep going, so don't be too sad."

"The apocalypse is so cruel." Xiaopang burst into tears. "I really want to eat Jin Kee's braised pig's trotters and roast duck..."
